Corollary
[positive Euler characteristic in dimension six]

Source: petersen:page-0336 ↗ thm:pet-ch8-euler-characteristic-zero-set-sum ↗ thm:pet-ch8-zero-set-totally-geodesic 1. ch8:8.3.3If $M$ is a compact $6$-manifold with positive sectional curvature that admits a Killing field, then $\chi (M)>0$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch8-positive-euler-characteristic-6manifold \sketch A zero exists by section 3. By section 1, every zero component is positively curved and has dimension $0$, $2$, or $4$. Each has positive Euler characteristic, using the low-dimensional argument in section 3. The formula in section 3 then makes $\chi (M)$ a nonempty sum of positive integers.

□
